integrity: An exact proof, two replayable verification scripts, and their stdout are bundled. Numerical diagnostics do not substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed states only; no basin, full period or convergence-time classification. Historical-priority uncertainty remains because the 1992 methods report was not available in complete text. The large-length prefactor is parity dependent; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp fixed-point entropy contrast for majority and minority dynamics on helm graphs
